candidates.title: Move sign-in after pet adoption
candidates.change: Reorder the onboarding sequence so users select and customize their pet before signing in. The sign-in prompt is presented right before pet generation.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 60.9% conversion rate and sign-in drops 27.1% of users before they build emotional investment with a pet.

sign_in.headline: Save Your New Desktop Pet
sign_in.hint: Sign in to bond this pet to your account permanently.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in to occur after pet adoption is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Delaying sign-in until after value delivery improves conversion, but flow reordering requires structural app changes.

candidates.why: The waiting step has a mean duration of 2336s (median 201s), and support received multiple complaints about not knowing how to control or hide pets post-onboarding.
